verse.verse_1: Verily! We have sent it (this Quran) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree)
verse.verse_2: And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is?
verse.verse_3: The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allah in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, (i.e. 83 years and 4 months).
verse.verse_4: Therein descend the angels and the Ruh [Jibrael (Gabriel)] by Allah's Permission with all Decrees,
verse.verse_5: Peace! (All that night, there is Peace and Goodness from Allah to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.
